# sqlite-graphrag (v1.1.07 LLM-Only One-Shot)

> Persistent memory for 27 AI agents in a single ~19 MiB Rust binary (LLM-only, one-shot)

27 AI agents. One ~19 MiB binary. Zero model download. sqlite-graphrag v1.1.06 (current, 2026-07-12 — the crate manifest carries `version = "1.1.6"` because the SemVer parser rejects a leading zero in the patch component; NO schema migration, schema stays at v16 from v1.1.04; closes GAP-ENTITY-CONNECT-SCAN-CARTESIAN (O(k) co-occurrence+hub×island entity-connect scan, pair:{id1}:{id2} keys, first-scan InterruptHandle timeout exit 1, scan_start NDJSON, suite v1106, ADR-0066); previous v1.1.05 closed the five operator-blocking bugs from the 2026-07-08 deep-research "danilo" incident in gaps.md: Bug 1 single-token deep-research expands to multi-aspect sub-queries (`source: "aspect"`, EN/PT facets; manual via `--sub-query-strategy manual --sub-queries-file`); Bug 2 `deep-research --output PATH` atomwrite + stdout ack with blake3 + global `--quiet`/`-q` (never `&>`); Bug 3 `graph traverse --fuzzy` + NotFound Jaro-Winkler/prefix suggestions; Bug 4 `merge-entities` rejects self-ref before any DB work; Bug 5 `link --from-id`/`--to-id`, pure digit names rejected; suite `tests/v1105_danilo_bugs_regression.rs`); v1.1.04 (previous) closes the two structural gaps tracked in gaps.md: GAP-001 the `deep-research` nested-Tokio-runtime panic is fixed (sync entry point computes per-sub-query embeddings BEFORE building its dedicated runtime via `compute_sub_embeddings`, and the three OpenRouter embedding paths in embedder.rs adopt the `Handle::try_current` + `block_in_place` reentry pattern; `ingest_opencode` also guarded), GAP-002 `entity-connect` now converges (new `entity_connect_seen` table records the LLM verdict per pair, scanner excludes evaluated pairs, `count_operation_backlog` reports a real O(n) backlog, `--until-empty` reaches `eligible_remaining == 0`); v1.1.03 closes the six operator-blocking bugs catalogued in gaps.md plus the V8 oversized-body gate; the crate manifest carries `version = "1.1.3"` because the SemVer parser rejects a leading zero in the patch component; no migration, schema v15; v1.1.02 closes the two residual gaps left after v1.1.01: the deprecated `--gliner-variant` no-op argument is fully removed (clap rejects it with exit 2, dead GLiNER plumbing deleted), the embedding token ceiling becomes the typed exit-6 error `AppError::TooManyTokens { tokens, limit }` enforced at the write boundary, a regression test guards the re-embed entity dispatch, and `enrich --prune-dead-entity-orphans` prunes entity-keyed dead-letter rows; v1.1.01 closed the 12-priority gaps.md roadmap from the production-database audit: P1 entity vectors are no longer silently skipped at write time — with `--embedding-backend openrouter` the entity-embedding chain resolves to `[OpenRouter]` even under `--llm-backend none` (REST, no subprocess) and an empty-vector guard on `upsert_entity_vec`/`upsert_chunk_vec`/`memories::upsert_vec` never persists an empty BLOB; P2 retroactive backfill via `enrich --operation re-embed --target memories|entities|chunks|all` (default `memories`) with per-target `scan_backlog` in `--status`; P3 `graph recompute-degree` reconciles the cached `entities.degree` with real edge counts in one transaction, with `--dry-run` and a `{total, updated, zeroed, unchanged}` envelope; P4 `reclassify-relation --literal-from` matches the stored relation VERBATIM (no clap normalization) so legacy hyphenated edges like `applies-to` migrate; P5 `merge-entities --ids/--into-id` and `rename-entity --id` for namespace-scoped ID disambiguation; P6 `health --json` gains `vec_*_missing`/`vec_*_coverage_pct` and `embedding status --json` gains per-table `*_missing` counters; P7 `EntityType` manual `Deserialize` with a rich error listing the 13 valid values and early validation in `--graph-stdin`; P10 re-embed predicates also select divergent `dim` and empty blobs across all three vector tables; P11 typed `AppError::BodyTooLarge`/`AppError::TooManyChunks` with bytes/chunks + limit in the envelope (exit 6 preserved); P12 `ingest --name-prefix` with cap validation; User-Agent `sqlite-graphrag/1.1.2` via CARGO_PKG_VERSION; v1.1.0 GAP-SG-70..78 fixed the enrich dead-letter backlog at the root: truncated completions (`finish_reason=length`) retry with a grown `max_tokens`, retry classification is typed by `AppError` variant (no message-substring matching), `--list-dead` gains `finish_reason`/`input_tokens`/`output_tokens` diagnostics, `--status` gains per-operation `scan_backlog`, and the dequeue loop is bounded under `SQLITE_BUSY` contention (exit 15); v1.0.99 GAP-SG-67 removed destructive degree-cap pruning + `--max-entity-degree` flag from remember/link (BREAKING, clap exit 2; writes purely additive, never delete edges); GAP-SG-68 aligned `graph entities --sort-by degree` doc to ascending behaviour (`--order desc` for most-connected-first); GAP-SG-69 `enrich body-enrich --until-empty` converges (scan skips preservation-vetoed bodies); no migration, schema v15; v1.0.97 enrich dead-letter recovery + write ergonomics: `--requeue-dead`/`--list-dead`/`--ignore-backoff`/`--prune-dead-orphans` (deletes dead memory queue entries whose key no longer exists in the main db, GAP-SG-66, ADR-0058), `--status`/`--list-dead`/`--requeue-dead`/`--prune-dead-orphans` run without `--operation`/`--mode`, new `augment-bindings` operation (requires `--names`), `body-extract --body-extract-graph-only`, `--max-attempts` default 8, `--openrouter-timeout` default 600s; `remember --graph-file`/`--strict-name`/`--replace-graph`; `ingest --force-merge` with `body_hash` dedup and native large-body auto-split; `read --format raw`; `unlink --memory/--entity`; `embedding status` `coverage` object; `stats` top-level `total_memories`; `--db` belongs after the subcommand while `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_DB_PATH` is the canonical override (GAP-20, SG-32); v1.0.96 enrich dead-letter + bounded REST fan-out (ADR-0055): `enrich --until-empty` runs an internal scan->drain loop until the eligible queue empties or `--max-runtime` expires, a dead-letter queue adds `error_class`/`next_retry_at` columns plus a terminal `dead` status so the backlog strictly converges (GAP-ENRICH-BACKLOG-CONVERGE), new `--max-attempts`/`--status`/`--rest-concurrency` flags, and OpenRouter REST embedding fans out per 32-chunk batch via a bounded `tokio::task::JoinSet` (GAP-OPENROUTER-REST-CONCURRENCY); v1.0.95 OpenRouter chat enrich (ADR-0054, GAP-OR-ENRICH): `enrich --mode openrouter` routes the enrich judge to the OpenRouter `/chat/completions` REST endpoint with no local CLI; v1.0.94 four-gap remediation: default embedding dim 384, enrich --mode required, embedding timeout 300s, entity embedding honours the selected backend; v1.0.93 added optional OpenRouter REST API embedding backend via `--embedding-backend openrouter` with ~100-500ms latency vs 20-60s subprocess LLM, `--enrich-after` flag for ingest, 5 BUG-OR fixes; v1.0.91 fixed GAP-SPAWN-001 spawn CWD isolation, BUG-17 degree fix, BUG-15/16 schema fixes; v1.0.90 added OpenCode backend; v1.0.89 schema drift via schemars; v1.0.87 preflight validation layer; v1.0.79 was the LLM-only foundation) gives every AI coding assistant a local, fast, private memory layer backed by a single SQLite file. Embedding generation uses EITHER a headless LLM subprocess (claude/codex/opencode via OAuth) OR the OpenRouter REST API (v1.0.93, via `--embedding-backend openrouter`). No daemon, no ONNX runtime, no model download. Graph-native retrieval. Deterministic JSON output ready for pipeline orchestration.

- Read this document in [Portuguese (pt-BR)](llms.pt-BR.txt).
- Architecture rationale: [ADR-0019](docs/decisions/adr-0019-llm-only-one-shot.md) (LLM-only one-shot), [ADR-0020](docs/decisions/adr-0020-pure-rust-cosine.md) (pure-Rust cosine), [ADR-0021](docs/decisions/adr-0021-deprecate-daemon.md) (daemon deprecated), [ADR-0022](docs/decisions/adr-0022-blob-embeddings.md) (BLOB-backed embeddings), [ADR-0023](docs/decisions/adr-0023-remove-tokenizers.md) (tokenizers removed), [ADR-0024](docs/decisions/adr-0024-fts5-coarse-cosine-refine.md) (FTS5 coarse + cosine refine), [ADR-0025](docs/decisions/adr-0025-oauth-only-embedding.md) (OAuth-only LLM), [ADR-0052](docs/decisions/adr-0052-openrouter-embedding-backend.md) (OpenRouter embedding backend)


## v1.0.85 Architecture (LLM-Only, supersedes v1.0.79)
- The default build is LLM-only and one-shot. There is no daemon, no ONNX runtime, no `libonnxruntime.so` to ship, and no `multilingual-e5-small` model to download. The LLM subprocess IS the model.
- Embedding generation: a headless `claude code` (Anthropic OAuth) or `codex` (ChatGPT Pro OAuth) subprocess is spawned per call. The CLI never holds an embedding model in memory.
- Vector search: cosine similarity is computed in pure Rust over the BLOB embeddings stored in `memory_embeddings`, `entity_embeddings`, and `chunk_embeddings`. The `sqlite-vec` extension is gone.
- Daemon: deprecated in v1.0.76 and FULLY REMOVED in v1.0.79 (ahead of the v1.1.0 schedule). The CLI is 100% one-shot with zero IPC.
- `embedding-legacy`, `ner-legacy` and `full` features: REMOVED in v1.0.79 (ahead of the v1.1.0 schedule) together with the optional fastembed/ort/ndarray/tokenizers/hf-hub dependencies. Every build is LLM-only.
- Embedding pipeline (G42, v1.0.79): default dimensionality 64 (`--embedding-dim`, `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_EMBEDDING_DIM`, range [8, 4096]; precedence flag > env > `schema_meta.dim` > 384); batched calls (calibration bases of 8 chunks / 25 entity names at dim 64, adapted as clamp(base×64/dim, 1, base) — G44); bounded parallelism via `--llm-parallelism` on `remember` (default 4), `ingest` (default 2) and `edit`; every subprocess uses `kill_on_drop` plus `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_EMBED_TIMEOUT_SECS` (default 300s).
- Canonical re-embed: `enrich --operation re-embed --limit N --resume` (v1.1.01 adds `--target memories|entities|chunks|all`, default `memories`); single-memory re-embed via `edit --force-reembed`.
- Migration from v1.0.74/v1.0.75: `sqlite-graphrag migrate --to-llm-only --drop-vec-tables --db <path>` is the one-shot upgrade. Combines checksum rewrite (--rehash) with V013 vec-table drop. The BLOB-backed embedding tables stay empty until the next `remember` / `edit` / `ingest` re-embeds via the LLM.


## v1.0.86 → v1.0.91 Architecture (Pre-flight, Schema Drift, Flag Parity, OpenCode Backend, Spawn Isolation)
- v1.0.86 added 10 LLM-pipeline subcommands: `pending list|show|cleanup`, `embedding status|list|abandon`, `pending-embeddings list|process`, `slots status|release`. New global flags: `--max-concurrency`, `--wait-lock`, `--llm-parallelism`, `--ingest-parallelism`, `--graceful-shutdown-secs`, `--skip-embedding-on-failure`. Host-wide slot semaphore via `fs4` with `fcntl(F_SETLK)` on Unix and `LockFileEx` on Windows (ADR-0036, 0037, 0038, 0039, 0040)
- v1.0.87 added the pre-flight validation layer: `src/spawn/preflight.rs` (≥200 lines, 7 guards, 15 unit tests) gates every LLM subprocess spawn BEFORE the fork. New `AppError::PreFlightFailed(PreFlightError)` with `exit_code() == 16` (`EX_CONFIG`, `is_permanent() == true`). The 7 guards in order: `check_argv_size`, `check_binary_exists`, `check_mcp_config_inline`, `check_mcp_config_path`, `check_walkup_mcp_json`, `check_output_buffer`, `check_claude_config_dir`. Bypass via `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_SKIP_PREFLIGHT=1` (ADR-0045, GAP-META-005)
- v1.0.88 hotfixes: BUG-11 (CRITICAL) preflight failure in `extract/llm_embedding.rs:563-565` now propagates to `remember` via `embed_via_backend_strict`; BUG-12 (MEDIUM) OAuth-only enforcement emits 1 stderr line (was 2); BUG-13 (MEDIUM) `link --create-missing` respects entity-name validation. 11 new regression tests (ADR-0046, ADR-0047)
- v1.0.89 schema drift + flag parity: `health.schema.json` regenerated via `schemars` derive macro (Must-Ignore policy per RFC 7493 I-JSON, `additionalProperties: true`); 17 new fields added. 5 subcommands now accept `--db <PATH>`: `embedding status|list|abandon`, `pending list|show`. `migrate --dry-run --json` reports pending migrations without applying. `codex-models --json` accepted as no-op. `ingest --auto-describe` (default true) extracts description from first meaningful body line. `health --namespace <NS> --json` filters counts. Binary size 14.6 MiB documented in `Cargo.toml:6` (ADR-0048, ADR-0049)
- v1.0.90 OpenCode backend integration (ADR-0051): third LLM backend `opencode run` alongside `codex exec` and `claude -p`. New `--llm-backend opencode`, `--mode opencode` for ingest/enrich, `--opencode-binary/model/timeout` flags and `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_OPENCODE_*` env vars. Fallback chain extended to `codex → claude → opencode → none`. 24-bug remediation including `--skip-embedding-on-failure` activation, `--llm-fallback` dead-flag fix, FTS desync in batch/enrich, Windows cross-compilation, embedding timeout hardcode, `list` pagination, `--yes` enforcement on destructive commands
- v1.0.91 spawn CWD isolation: `spawn_isolation_dir()` and `apply_cwd_isolation()` in `src/spawn/mod.rs` set `current_dir` to an ephemeral temp directory and `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` to the same dir for ALL 10 production spawn sites. LLM subprocesses no longer inherit `.mcp.json` from the caller's project — embedding works zero-config in any directory. `cleanup_spawn_dir()` removes the temp dir at process exit. BUG-17 fixed `entities.degree` inflation: `increment_degree()` replaced by `recalculate_degree()` after all relationships are inserted. BUG-15/16 fixed 8 JSON schemas with missing enum values and fields


## v1.0.93 Architecture (OpenRouter Embedding Backend)
- v1.0.93 adds optional OpenRouter REST API embedding backend via `--embedding-backend auto|openrouter|llm` global flag (ADR-0052, GAP-OR-INGEST)
- `EmbeddingBackendChoice` enum (`Auto`, `Openrouter`, `Llm`) is separate from `LlmBackendChoice` — embedding and LLM extraction are independent selections
- `--embedding-model MODEL` selects the OpenRouter model; NO default — user MUST specify when using `--embedding-backend openrouter`
- `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` env var or `--openrouter-api-key` flag provides the API key (handled via `secrecy::SecretString` with zeroize-on-drop, NEVER logged)
- Direct REST API via `reqwest+rustls-tls` to `POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/embeddings` — ~100-500ms vs 20-60s subprocess LLM cold-start
- MRL (Matryoshka Representation Learning) truncation to configured `--embedding-dim` (default 384)
- 10 verified models: `qwen/qwen3-embedding-4b`, `qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b`, `nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2:free`, `openai/text-embedding-3-small`, `openai/text-embedding-3-large`, `perplexity/pplx-embed-v1-0.6b`, `mistralai/mistral-embed-2312`, `baai/bge-m3`, `google/gemini-embedding-001`, `google/gemini-embedding-2`
- `EmbeddingBackendChoice` propagated to ALL 8 embedding commands: `remember`, `remember-batch`, `ingest`, `recall`, `edit`, `restore`, `hybrid-search`, `deep-research`
- `--enrich-after` flag on `ingest` triggers `enrich --operation memory-bindings` sequentially after all files are ingested
- BUG-OR-1 through BUG-OR-5: input_type per model, MRL detection, model validation, HTTP 200 malformed retry, dimension override

## Core Commands
### Subcommands grouped by lifecycle
- `init` initializes the SQLite database and validates that an LLM CLI (`claude`, `codex` or `opencode`) is reachable on `PATH`. No model download.
- `remember` saves a memory with name, type, description, body and optional entity graph; spawning an LLM subprocess per call for embedding generation
- `recall` performs pure-Rust cosine KNN similarity search over stored BLOB embeddings
- `hybrid-search` fuses FTS5 full-text and pure-Rust cosine KNN via Reciprocal Rank Fusion
- `deep-research` decomposes a query into up to 7 sub-queries (single-token queries expand to multi-aspect sub-queries with `source: "aspect"`, EN/PT facets; manual via `--sub-query-strategy manual --sub-queries-file`, v1.1.05), computes a separate embedding per sub-query, runs parallel vector+FTS hybrid search fused via RRF plus 3-hop graph traversal per sub-query, deduplicates and assembles directed evidence chains; `--output PATH` writes the full envelope via atomwrite and emits a short stdout ack with `blake3`; pair with global `--quiet`/`-q`
- `read` `list` `forget` `rename` `edit` `history` `restore` manage the memory lifecycle
- `remember-batch` ingests multiple memories from a NDJSON stream in a single invocation
- `completions` generates shell completion scripts for bash, zsh, fish, elvish and powershell
- `link` `unlink` `related` manage typed entity relationships for multi-hop traversal; `link --from-id`/`--to-id` (v1.1.05) resolve by ID; pure digit names are rejected so `--create-missing` cannot create ghost numeric entities; `graph traverse --fuzzy` (v1.1.05) auto-resolves clear short-name winners and NotFound suggests ranked canonical names without `--fuzzy`
- `health` `stats` `migrate` `vacuum` `optimize` `sync-safe-copy` manage the database
- `migrate --rehash` rewrites recorded migration checksums to match the current file content (one-shot fix for v1.0.74 → v1.0.76 V002 mismatch)
- `migrate --to-llm-only --drop-vec-tables` one-shot upgrade for v1.0.74/v1.0.75 databases: rehash + apply V013 + report vec-table state
- `backup` creates a consistent database backup using SQLite Online Backup API, safe with WAL mode
- `fts rebuild` `fts check` `fts stats` repair, verify, and inspect the FTS5 full-text index
- `memory-entities` lists all entities linked to a named memory
- `delete-entity` removes an entity and optionally cascades to its relationships
- `rename-entity` renames a graph entity preserving all FK-based relationships and re-embeds for vector search; `--id <id>` (v1.1.01) selects by ID for namespace-scoped disambiguation
- `reclassify` changes the `entity_type` of one entity or a whole category via `--batch`
- `merge-entities` merges duplicate entity nodes into a single canonical node; `--ids <csv>`/`--into-id <id>` (v1.1.01) select by ID when duplicated names across namespaces block name-based merges; `--cross-namespace` (v1.1.03, opt-in, default same-namespace) lets `--ids`/`--into-id` resolve across all namespaces; self-referential merges (`--into-id` in `--ids`, or `--into` in `--names`) are rejected BEFORE any DB work (v1.1.05)
- `prune-ner` removes NER-generated bindings from one entity (`--entity`) or all (`--all --yes`)
- `remember --dry-run` previews parsing and graph extraction without writing to the database or spawning the LLM
- `cleanup-orphans` `prune-relations` remove orphaned entities and weak or unused relations from the graph
- `purge` `namespace-detect` handle maintenance and namespace resolution
- `reclassify-relation` renames relationship types across the graph; `--literal-from` (v1.1.01) matches the stored relation verbatim (no normalization) so legacy hyphenated edges migrate; `--literal-to <RELATION>` (v1.1.03) writes the target verbatim, so `--literal-from applies_to --literal-to applies-to --batch` migrates legacy underscore edges to canonical hyphen form
- `normalize-entities` normalizes all entity names in the namespace to lowercase kebab-case ASCII
- `graph recompute-degree` (v1.1.01) reconciles the cached `entities.degree` with the real edge counts in one transaction, per namespace or all; `--dry-run` previews, envelope `{total, updated, zeroed, unchanged}`
- `split-body` (v1.1.03) divides memories whose body exceeds 25 000 characters into daughter memories at chunk boundaries, marks the original superseded, and creates canonical `replaces` relations from each daughter to the original; daughters are NOT embedded inline — run `enrich --operation re-embed --target memories` afterwards
- `enrich` LLM-augmented graph quality pipeline via `--mode claude-code|codex|opencode|openrouter` (openrouter requires `--openrouter-model`); FULLY-IMPLEMENTED ops: `memory-bindings`, `entity-descriptions`, `body-enrich`, `re-embed` (`--target memories|entities|chunks|all`), `augment-bindings` (requires `--names`), `body-extract` (+ `--body-extract-graph-only`), `entity-connect` (**v1.1.06**: O(k) co-occurrence+hub×island scan, keys `pair:{id1}:{id2}` / `item_type=entity_pair`, drain by PK, first-scan `InterruptHandle` → Timeout exit **1** ≠ 75, NDJSON `scan_start`/`scan_meta`, GAP-002 `entity_connect_seen` preserved), `cross-domain-bridges` (same O(k) path); `--reset-stale-claims` / `--stale-claim-secs <N>` (v1.1.03); NDJSON phases/items/summary; suite `tests/v1106_entity_connect_scan_regression.rs`; ADR-0066


## Environment Variables
### Runtime configuration surface
- `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_DB_PATH` explicit override for the SQLite database path
- Default behavior creates or opens `graphrag.sqlite` in the current working directory
- `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_CACHE_DIR` directory for cache and lock files (model cache only on builds ≤ v1.0.75)
- `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_EMBEDDING_DIM` embedding dimensionality override (v1.0.79, range [8, 4096], default **384** since v1.0.94)
- `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_CLAUDE_EMBED_MODEL` model override for `claude -p` embedding calls (v1.0.79)
- `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_EMBED_TIMEOUT_SECS` timeout per LLM embedding subprocess call (v1.0.79, default 300)
- `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_LOG_LEVEL` tracing filter level with values `error` through `trace`
- `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_LANG` CLI output language with values `en` or `pt`
- `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_NAMESPACE` namespace override respected by all commands (fixed in v1.0.51)
- `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` API key for OpenRouter embedding backend (v1.0.93); handled via `secrecy::SecretString`
- `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_EMBEDDING_BACKEND` persistent embedding backend selection (`auto`, `openrouter`, `llm`)
- `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL` persistent embedding model for OpenRouter backend


## Graph Input
### Minimal payload contract for `remember`
- `--entities-file` expects a JSON array of entity objects
- Each entity must include `name` plus `entity_type` or alias `type`
- Valid `entity_type` values: `project`, `tool`, `person`, `file`, `concept`, `incident`, `decision`, `memory`, `dashboard`, `issue_tracker`, `organization`, `location`, `date`
- `--relationships-file` expects a JSON array of relationship objects
- Each relationship must include `source`/`from`, `target`/`to`, `relation`, and `strength`
- `strength` must be a float in `[0.0, 1.0]` and maps to `weight` in graph outputs
- File payload relations use underscore labels like `applies_to`, `depends_on`, and `tracked_in`; dashed aliases are normalized before storage
- CLI flags on `link` and `unlink` use dashed labels like `applies-to`, `depends-on`, and `tracked-in`


## Automatic Extraction
### URL-regex extraction (GLiNER removed in v1.0.79)
- Pass `--enable-ner` or set `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_ENABLE_NER=1` to activate on `remember` and `ingest`
- Since v1.0.79 this runs URL-regex extraction ONLY — the GLiNER zero-shot pipeline was removed with the `ner-legacy` feature
- `--gliner-variant`, `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_GLINER_MODEL` and `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_GLINER_THRESHOLD` are accepted for compatibility but have NO effect
- Response field `extraction_method`: `url-regex`, `regex-only`, or `none:extraction-failed`
- For LLM-curated extraction use `ingest --mode claude-code` or `ingest --mode codex`; for exact control use `--graph-stdin`
- `--skip-extraction` is deprecated since v1.0.45 and has no effect
- `--max-rss-mb <MiB>` on `remember` and `ingest` aborts embedding when process RSS exceeds the threshold (default 8192 MiB)

## Ingest Modes (v1.0.62)
### Three extraction modes for bulk ingestion
- `--mode none` (default): body-only ingestion, no entity/relationship extraction
- `--mode gliner`: accepted for compatibility, but URL-regex extraction only since v1.0.79 (GLiNER/ONNX removed)
- `--mode claude-code`: LLM-curated extraction via locally installed Claude Code CLI binary
- Claude Code mode spawns `claude -p` headless with `--json-schema` for structured entity/relationship output
- Requires Claude Code >= 2.1.0 installed on the user's machine with active Pro/Max subscription
- Resumable via `--resume` flag with SQLite queue DB tracking per-file progress
- Per-file subprocess timeout via `--claude-timeout <S>` (default 300s); kills hung `claude -p` processes
- Budget control via `--max-cost-usd <N>` to limit cumulative API spend
- Rate limit handling with automatic exponential backoff (60s → 120s → 300s → 900s)
- Output is NDJSON: per-file events with `entities`, `rels`, `cost_usd` fields, followed by summary
- `--mode codex` spawns `codex exec --json` per file for LLM-curated extraction via OpenAI Codex CLI
- Requires Codex CLI installed locally; uses `--output-schema` for structured JSON output
- Codex-specific flags: `--codex-binary <PATH>`, `--codex-model <MODEL>`, `--codex-timeout <S>` (default 300)
- Environment variable `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_CODEX_BINARY` overrides PATH lookup
- Token usage tracking via `input_tokens` and `output_tokens` fields (cost_usd unavailable from Codex CLI)
- Full embedding pipeline applied to Codex-ingested memories for recall and hybrid-search

Authentication: OAuth works out of the box for both modes — no API key needed.
--mode claude-code reads OAuth from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (Claude Pro/Max/Team).
--mode codex reads device auth from codex auth login (OpenAI).
API keys (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY) ABORT the spawn with AppError::Validation. OAuth is the ONLY accepted credential flow.


## Exit Codes
### Deterministic status for pipeline routing
- `0` success: continue the agent loop
- `1` validation or runtime failure: log and surface to operator
- `2` invalid CLI argument: fix usage then retry
- `9` duplicate memory detected: skip or use `--force-merge`
- `3` optimistic update conflict: re-read `updated_at` and retry
- `4` memory or entity not found: handle missing resource gracefully
- `5` namespace could not be resolved: pass `--namespace` explicitly
- `6` payload exceeded configured limits: split body into smaller chunks
- `10` SQLite database error: run `health` to inspect integrity
- `11` embedding generation failed: check LLM CLI availability and retry
- `13` batch partial failure: honor backoff and retry later
- `14` filesystem I/O error: cache directory not writable, nonexistent ingest target directory
- `15` database busy after retries: wait and retry
- `16` pre-flight validation failed (v1.0.87+): fix MCP config or binary path, see envelope for variant
- `19` SHUTDOWN: graceful shutdown interrupted work, partial state discarded, RETRY REQUIRED
- `20` internal or JSON serialization error
- `75` EX_TEMPFAIL: all concurrency slots busy OR job singleton locked, retry with backoff
- `77` available RAM below minimum required for LLM subprocess


## What Changed in v1.0.79
### G42: fast, parallel, robust LLM embedding pipeline
- Configurable embedding dimensionality, default 384 (`--embedding-dim`; precedence flag > `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_EMBEDDING_DIM` > `schema_meta.dim` > 384; existing 384-dim databases keep working unchanged; ZERO schema change)
- Batched LLM calls: calibration bases of 8 chunks / 25 entity names at dim 64, adapted as clamp(base×64/dim, 1, base) per call (`{items:[{i,v}]}` schema, G44) — 39 spawns collapse into 4-5
- Bounded parallelism (`Semaphore` + `JoinSet`): new `--llm-parallelism` on `remember` (default 4), `ingest` (default 2), `edit`; permits clamp [1, 32]
- `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_CLAUDE_EMBED_MODEL` and `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_EMBED_TIMEOUT_SECS` (default 300s) env overrides; `kill_on_drop` on every LLM subprocess
- Empty `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` by default on the embedding path (~40-50s → ~10-15s per call)
- Panic-free signal handler: second signal exits 130 with zero I/O; SIGPIPE exits 141
- Canonical re-embed: `enrich --operation re-embed --limit N --resume` plus `edit --force-reembed`; v1.1.01 adds `--target memories|entities|chunks|all` for entity/chunk backfill
- `validate_dim` errors on divergent vectors instead of silently truncating/padding
- REMOVED: daemon infrastructure; `embedding-legacy`/`ner-legacy`/`full` features and fastembed/ort/ndarray/tokenizers/hf-hub optional deps

## What Changed in v1.0.68
### Critical fixes (G28 + G29)
- v1.0.68 is the first release since v1.0.65 that compiles on Windows via `cargo install`.  v1.0.66 and v1.0.67 broke with `error[E0308]` in `src/terminal.rs:29` because `HANDLE` in `windows-sys >= 0.59` is `*mut c_void` (was `isize` in 0.48/0.52).  Fix: `!handle.is_null() && handle != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE` plus `windows-sys` pinned to `=0.59.0` exact, plus CI job `windows-build-check`.
- `enrich`, `ingest --mode claude-code`, and `ingest --mode codex` now acquire a per-namespace singleton via `lock::acquire_job_singleton(job_type, namespace, wait_seconds)`.  A second concurrent invocation on the same database returns `AppError::JobSingletonLocked { job_type, namespace }` (exit 75, retryable) instead of stacking 4 × N workers × 10 MCP servers.
- `claude_runner::build_claude_command` now respects `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_CLAUDE_EMPTY_CONFIG_DIR` (opt-in).  When set to an empty directory, the subprocess is spawned with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<that dir>`, suppressing user-scoped MCP servers.  This is the only mechanism Claude Code actually honours — `--strict-mcp-config` and `--mcp-config '{}'` are silently ignored per [anthropics/claude-code#10787].
- `enrich` emits a `tracing::warn!` when `--llm-parallelism > 4`, recommending the combination with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` override.
- `retry::CircuitBreaker` helper added with `AttemptOutcome::{Success, Transient, HardFailure}`.  Rate-limited and timeout errors are explicitly excluded from the failure count.
- 3 pre-existing test failures in `src/commands/{history,list,read}.rs` fixed (timezone-agnostic assertions).

MSRV Rust 1.88. Binary ~19 MiB.
- Repository `https://github.com/danilo-aguiar-br/sqlite-graphrag` without GitHub Actions CI (releases published manually)
- Embedding model: delegated to OpenRouter REST API (v1.0.93, ~100-500ms) OR headless `claude code` / `codex` / `opencode` subprocess (OAuth, ~20-60s) per call; no in-process model
- Storage layer: `rusqlite` with bundled SQLite and FTS5 module. `sqlite-vec` extension REMOVED in v1.0.76; vector similarity is pure-Rust cosine over BLOB embeddings
- Up to four concurrent instances supported via counting semaphore with `fs4` advisory locks
- Official agent catalogue: **27** AI agents and IDEs supported out of the box (README section); crate description matches this count
### Schema and storage
- Current main-database schema version is **16** (`CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION`); v1.1.06 does **not** add a migration
- Schema v16 introduced in v1.1.04 via migration V016: table `entity_connect_seen(source_id, target_id, namespace, verdict, relation, evaluated_at)` with composite PK, dual `ON DELETE CASCADE` FKs to `entities(id)`, verdict CHECK, namespace index
- Embeddings stored as BLOB in `memory_embeddings` / `entity_embeddings` / `chunk_embeddings`; cosine is pure Rust; default dim **384** (MRL truncation supported)
- Enrich queue lives in sidecar `.enrich-queue.sqlite` next to the main DB (dead-letter `dead`, `error_class`, `next_retry_at`, `claimed_at`)
### Exit codes (operator-critical)
- `0` success; `1` validation **or** wall-clock Timeout (including first-scan entity-connect `InterruptHandle`); `2` CLI args; `3` optimistic lock; `4` not found (may include suggestions); `6` payload too large; `11` embedding failure; `15` SQLITE_BUSY; `16` preflight; `19` SHUTDOWN (retry required); `75` job singleton / slot lock (**not** scan timeout); `78` missing OpenRouter key/model
- NEVER treat entity-connect first-scan Timeout as exit `75`
### Enrich entity-connect (v1.1.06 contract)
- Queue keys `pair:{id1}:{id2}` with `item_type=entity_pair`; drain by primary key without re-scan
- Pair candidates: co-occurrence in `memory_entities` + hub × degree-0 island fill (O(k); never cartesian O(n²))
- NDJSON: `scan_start` **before** SQL with real `operation` (`entity-connect` or `cross-domain-bridges`), `entities_in_namespace`, `backlog_degree0_proxy`; `scan_meta` with `pairs_enqueued_this_scan` / `scan_elapsed_ms` — do **not** equate the two backlog fields
- First scan covered by `--max-runtime` and soft 120s ceiling via `InterruptHandle` → Timeout exit **1**
- `cross-domain-bridges` shares the same O(k) scan + `entity_connect_seen` drain path; GAP-002 convergence preserved
- Suite: `tests/v1106_entity_connect_scan_regression.rs`; ADR-0066; pin library consumers `=1.1.7`
### Concurrency and credentials
- Per-namespace job singleton on `enrich` / LLM ingest modes → exit `75` under contention
- OAuth-only for `claude` / `codex` subprocesses: raw `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_API_KEY` ABORT spawn (exit 1)
- OpenRouter uses `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` (REST embedding and chat enrich); never log the key
### Retrieval defaults
- Hybrid retrieval: FTS5 BM25 + BLOB cosine KNN fused with RRF; multi-hop via `graph traverse` / `related` / `deep-research`
- Single-token `deep-research` fans out to aspect sub-queries (`source: "aspect"`) since v1.1.05; large envelopes use `--output` atomwrite + `--quiet`
